extracted.intended_audience: journal peer reviewers for Wiley journals (current and prospective reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: A resource hub listing guidance, policies, and training for people performing peer review for Wiley journals. Includes links to reviewer guides, confidentiality and review-model information, publishing-ethics best practices, external guidelines, and training materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our reviewer guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General, journal-specific instructions for performing peer review for Wiley journals (how to structure a review, expectations, suggested tone and scope). (This entry links to Wiley's primary reviewer guidance.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Results from our peer reviewer study
rubrics_metrics.description: See Results from our peer reviewer study
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use empirical findings about reviewer behavior and common issues to inform how you approach reviews (e.g., common pitfalls, effective practices). This resource provides study results rather than prescriptive rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality policy and check the review model
rubrics_metrics.description: Review Our confidentiality policy and check the review model for Wiley journals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before accepting or submitting a review, confirm and follow the journal's confidentiality policy and the journal's review model (single-blind, double-blind, open, transparent, etc.). Be aware of any restrictions on sharing manuscript content and of how reviewer identities and reports will be handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wiley’s Best Practice Guidelines on Publishing Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Wiley’s Best Practice Guidelines on Publishing Ethics
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to Wiley's publishing-ethics standards when reviewing: identify potential misconduct, conflicts of interest, authorship concerns, data integrity issues, and report them per publisher guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: COPE: Ethical guidelines for reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE) Ethical guidelines for reviewers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow COPE's reviewer ethics: maintain confidentiality, declare conflicts of interest, be objective and constructive, avoid malicious or frivolous reviews, and report suspected ethical problems to editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review: The Nuts and the Bolts (Sense About Science)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer Review: The Nuts and the Bolts by Sense About Science (SAS)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this practical guide for fundamentals of peer review—what makes a helpful review, how to evaluate methods and claims, and how to communicate constructive criticism effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wiley Researcher Academy peer-review course
rubrics_metrics.description: All you need to know to become an effective peer reviewer: free course on Wiley Researcher Academy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete Wiley's free training to learn best practices for assessing manuscripts, writing reviews, ethical responsibilities, and practical tips for reviewers (useful for new reviewers or as a refresher).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent peer review: practices and lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparent Peer Review: What We’ve Learned
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand the implications and procedures of transparent/open peer review models: whether reviews or review histories may be published, how transparency affects tone and content of reviews, and considerations for consenting to open review.
